Alex / Marissa — a couple of technical and commercial constraints to call out before we finalize wording to Novamed: 

Technical notes:
- Persistent KV-cache: it's tightly coupled to the serving pool instance and GC lifecycle. We can't just flip it between tiers without re-provisioning the pool, but we can expose it as an add-on that mounts to their Compact pool. If they move to Full we can migrate the cache with a rolling sync; expect a 24–72 hour warm-up window depending on keys.
- Vector snapshot export: lightweight; can be treated as an on-demand export and included in a pro-data add-on.

Commercial proposal (recommended):
- KV-cache add-on: $2,000 onboarding + $1,000/month per active pool (pilot rate).
- Vector export: $150/export OR include up to 4 exports/month in Pro Data for $600/month.
- Pilot discount: 15% off combined fees if they commit to 6 months and token throughput >= 8M/mo.

If we want to be more aggressive on price we can offer a 20% discount in exchange for a short reference commitment and a 12-month option to convert to Dedicated. I'm attaching the license terms to make sure legal is comfortable with per-pool language.

Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Claire / Daniel — thanks for the patience. Based on the usage you sent and Ben's notes, recommended path below (concise):

Recommended pilot packaging (one-page):
- Start on Compact tier (saves ~30% on base generation costs)
- Add-ons enabled at launch:
  * Persistent KV-cache (per-pool license) — onboarding now; monthly license as Ben described.
  * Pro Data package — includes up to 4 vector exports/month (otherwise $150/export).
- Pricing & discounts: 15% pilot discount on base + add-ons for a 6-month commit at >=8M tokens/mo. If Novamed agrees to be a reference and signs a 12-month option we can increase to 20% for the first 6 months.
- Upgrade path: Compact+add-ons -> Full: can be done without client-visible downtime; we'll provision a Full pool, replicate KV-cache, run a 24–72 hour warm-up and then failover. We'll coordinate the canary windows with your ops team.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you want Compact+KV + Pro Data and the 6-month term.
2) If yes, Ben and I will prepare a one-page M.A.P. and a pilot SOW.
3) I will attach the pricing PDF and a HubSpot link to the draft deal so you can review approvals.
